book.name: Lucas
book.title: Hen anchi ammayay chamag way ensorat Lucas

content: Hen anchi nà-amfaro way iggayna iyanggayan way manchawat
Angkay hiyachi yag nampani ah Jesus hen anchichay pasorotna hen nangintudtuchuwana way ancha komag chan luwaluwaru way achi koma cha machischismaya hen hamhamàcha.
Ekatnéén, “Hen-argawan ano, wacha hen uwis hen ihay fabréy way ammag maid égyatna an Apudyus ya maid agé ifiinna ah ahentaguna.
Yag hen hiyachiy fabréy agé, wacha hen ihay nà-amfaro way ammag cha émé-éméy an Uwis way i mampatorong way mangaliyén, ‘Toronganà paat ta achiyà afaén hen anchi kakontarà.’
Ammag nafayag way achi pagan-anon Uwis hiya. Angkay hen anongohna way ammag nappég ah Uwis, ekatna ah hamhamànéén, ‘Tàén maid égyat-o an Apudyus ya uray maid iyafiin-o ah tatagu,
an-o chillug torongan hen annay fufaeyanna te ammag homaliwa yag tenémpég agé ah cha umaleale.’ ”
Angkay hiyachi yag ekat Apo Jesus way mangaliyén, “Tàén lawengay tagu hen anchi uwis, hamham-ényu ngén hen anchi enkamanna.

Wat ah Apudyus way ka-a-ammayan, ay achi kaskasen hen ekamanna way somofalet hen anchichay penelena way tatagu no anchag iyar-argaw ya enlabraficha way manchawat an hiya. Ay ammoh mampanaag ah Apudyus way manorong an chicha.
Hen ifagà an chàyu, ag-aggah yag tenoronganaat chicha. Ngém ah pegwana way mamfangchà way Pangorowan hen Tatagu, ay nanggilah wachay ichahà ah nangafurot an haén.”
Hen nanluwaruwan hen anchi Fariseo ya hen anchi cha mangam-among hen furor
Angkay hiyachi yag kasen nampani ah Jesus hen anchichay tatagu way anchag nanapnek ah kaenammaycha ya chachaat agé peet pelohon hen tapena.
Ekatnéén, “Hen-argawan ano, wachacha hen chuway tatagu way nane-ed ah Templo way i manluwaru way hen iha, Fariseo, ya hen anchi iha, wat ihay cha mangam-among hen furor.

Angkay ah faréy, i tommanig hen anchi Fariseo yag inlugina way manluwaru way mangaliyén, ‘Apudyus, manyamanà te faénà kaman hen anchichay tapena way anchag cha gamgaman hen heno ya nangéttémcha ya chacha amin chumagchagas. Ya manyamanà agé te faénà laweng way kaman hen annay cha mangam-among hen furor.
Te haénat, chinuminggu way manlanganà ah chuway ag-agaw way achi mangmangan, ya chà amin fayachan an hea hen pagkaporon hen egachay wacha an haén.’ ”

“Angkay hen anchi cha mangam-among ah furor, oma-adchawwéy way tommatàchég way achi paat mammuhmuhwat way mantangad te mafiinan, wat annag cha pagpagén hen faro-ongna ah mamfafawiyana hen fasorna. Yag ekatnéén, ‘Apudyus, anà ammag ség-angan koma paat an hea te menangfasorà.’ ”

Yachi yag inyanongoh Jesus way mangaliyén, “Hen ifagà an chàyu, hen anchi ammayén Apudyus wat hen anchi cha mangam-among ah furor angkay, yag faénat agé hen anchi Fariseo. Te heno way tagu way mangempachayaw hen acharna, ammag mepafiin chillu. Waman hen anchi tagu way mangimpudnu hen karawengna, mepachayaw ah pegwana.”
Hen namindisyunan Jesus hen ungunga
Angkay hiyachi yag wachacha hen anchichay cha manginyéy hen anàcha an Jesus ta tad-éna koma way mamindisyun. Ngém hen nangil-an hen anchichay pasorotna, anchaat agég cha amhiwén chicha.

Yag chaat chillu ayagan Jesus hen anchichay ungunga, yag annaat ifaga hen anchichay ifana way mangaliyén, “Eparufusyu hen annachay ungunga ta umalecha an haén, te hen anchichay kaman an chicha, wat chichachi hen metape hen mantorayan Apudyus.

Te tot-owa hen antoy ifagà an chàyu way uray heno way tagu way achi mangempafafa hen acharna hen omafurotana an Apudyus way kaman hen kafafan hen antochay ungunga, wat achi angkay mafalin way metape hen mantorayan Apudyus.”
Hen anchi faknang way annag pawadwad-én hen kafinaknangna
Angkay hiyachi yag wacha hen ihay ponò hen Judio way émméy an Jesus way mangaliyén, “Heay ammayay Apo, nokay hen ammaà ta mètaguwà an Apudyus ah ing-inggana.”
“Pakay ekatnowén ammayà,” way ekat Jesus, “te maid met kasen ammay no faén yanggay ah Apudyus.
Yag innilam met chillu hen orchin Apudyus way achita cha chumagchagas ya achita cha pomatéy, achita cha mangakaw ya achi cha istiguwan hen faén tot-owa, ya masapor rispituwén hen chinàcha-ar.”
Yag sommongfat hen anchi tagu way mangaliyén, “Oo ngén, tenongpar-o met amin chaha nanepod hen kaong-ongà.”

Angkay chengngar Jesus hen ekatna yag annaat ekatén, “An ihà-an peet yanggay hen korangno way masapor ammaam, wat im elao amin hen kok-owam yag inwarasno hen laona hen anchichay maid mafalinna, wat yachi hen marmuwan hen tot-oway kafinaknangno ad uchu. Yag an-aat umale way somorot an haén.”
Ngém hen nangngaranan nadchi, ammag ngommehpéy te hen hiyachiy tagu, ammag faknang way térén.
Hen nangil-an Jesus hen tenomkarana, annaat ekatén, “Ammag naligat way térén hen metapyan hen faknang hen mantorayan Apudyus.
Te ammag narakrakaat agé hen homroan hen kafayu hen matan hen chagum no hen metapyan hen faknang an Apudyus.”
Yachi yag anat ekat hen anchichay nangngarén, “Wat no yahaat, ay nanggilah wacha paat laway ihah metape an Apudyus.”
Ngém ekat Jesusén, “Hen anchi achi mafalin ammaan hen tatagu, mafalin chillu ammaan Apudyus.”
Yachi yag anat ekat Pedro an Jesusén, “Ilam ngén chàni, te tenaynanni amin hen fabréyni gapoh sommorotanni an hea.”
“Oo tot-owa,” way ekat Jesus, “yag hen ifagà an chàyu, heno way manaynan hen fabréyna ya ahawana ya sosnodna ya hen chinàcha-arna ya a-anàna ah manginwarawagana hen mepanggép hen mantorayan Apudyus,
wat chùchùar hen midchat an hiya hen antoy matatagguwana no hen tenaynana. Ya ah pegwana, mètagu agé an Apudyus ah ing-inggana.”
Hen kasen nangimfag-an Jesus hen matéyana

Angkay hiyachi yag enet-én Jesus hen anchichay hemporo ya chuway pasorotna yag imfagana way mangaliyén, “Changrényu ngén, te hen antoy chataaw ayan ad Jerusalem wat ma-ammaan an haén way Pangorowan hen Tatagu hen aminay ensorat hen anchichay profeta ad namenghan.
Te meporangà hen anchichay faén Judio way anà ammag sénsén-én yag ininsortowà ya tenoppaanà,
henapratanà ya ana-at narég pédtén. Yag hen anchi ma-atloy ag-agaw, man-uchiyà chillu.”
Imfagan Jesus aminchi ngém hen anchichay pasorotna, anchag iggay chillu ma-awatan hen imfagana te kaman paat netataro hen laychénay aryén wat achi éméy ah hamhamàcha.
Hen nanga-anan Jesus hen finurag hen anchi ihay palemmos
Angkay hiyachi way cha homag-én cha Jesus ad Jerico, wacha hen ihay nabfurag way tummutùchu hen penget hen korsa way chan pap-alemmos.
Yag hen nangngarana hen chan lawhan hen anchichay chuar way tatagu, chana imohon no nokay hen cha ma-ammaan.
Yag imfagacha way naway ah Jesus way eNazaret way manlooh.
Yag nan-ongawat agé hen anchi nabfurag way mangaliyén, “Heay Jesus way ganà David, panga-asem paat ta ség-anganà.”
Yag hen anchichay tatagu way cha mamangpango, iningarcha hiya way mangempaginang, yag chanaat chillu chakachakarén way man-ongaw way mangaliyén, “Heay ganà David, panga-asem paat ta ség-anganà.”
Wat entàchég Jesus yag empa-ayagna hen anchi nabfurag. Yag yachi way hommag-én, ekat Jesusén,
“Nokay hen laychém way ammaà an hea.” Yag ekatnéén, “Apo ta makailaà koma.”
Yag anat ekat Jesusén, “Wat ta makaila-aat, te gapo ta manokchum haén wat maka-an hen finuragno.”

Yag hen hiyachi, nakailaat hen anchi nabfurag yag anat metnod an Jesus way cha manayachayaw an Apudyus. Wat amin hen anchichay tatagu, chinayawcha agé ah Apudyus hen nangil-anchan nadchi way na-ammaan.
